subject: Pilot design session — aligning stakeholders, SSO and evidence needs
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot design session — aligning stakeholders, SSO and evidence needs

Hi Anna — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Goal: run a 2-week pilot to validate latency/cost for clinical MLP use-cases and evaluate SSO/KMS integration.
- Key stakeholders to include in the next meeting: your platform lead (SSO/SCIM), security reviewer, and procurement (for pilot contract).
- Deliverables for the session: demo of our pilot topology, SSO checklist, and evidence package (SOC2 summary + token handling).

Proposed times for a 60-minute pilot design session (all times PT):
- Wed Aug 20, 9:00–10:00am
- Wed Aug 20, 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu Aug 21, 11:00–12:00pm

If none of those work, please share two windows that do and we’ll adjust. I’m looping in Sofia (security lead) and Marissa (CS/ops) so we can answer technical and procurement questions live.

Attached: pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (outline + checklist).

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0139

---

From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@orionhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@orionhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 15:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot design session — aligning stakeholders, SSO and evidence needs

Thanks Sean — that summary captures it. Wed 8/20 at 2pm PT works best for my team.

Couple of asks before the call: 
- Can you include a short SSO/SCIM configuration checklist up front so our platform lead can do a quick pass?
- Our security team (security@orionhealth.com) will want the SOC2 scope and an outline of data retention for pilot tokens.
- Procurement would like a simple pilot agreement template to review (we will not sign anything more than a 30-day pilot).

Looping in Rajesh (platform) and security. If you can share the checklist and pilot agreement stub prior to the session that would speed things up.

Best,
Anna
Director of Product, Orion Health
anna.lopez@orionhealth.com

Perfect — Wed 8/20, 2:00–3:00pm PT is booked. Calendar invite attached. Quick checklist and templates attached for review: 
- redwood-ssoconfig-checklist.xlsx (SSO/SCIM pre-check)
- pilot-scope-appendix.pdf (already shared)
- pilot-agreement-stub.docx (standard 30-day pilot)

Sofia — can you confirm you'll be on the call to walk through the evidence package (SOC2 scope + token retention)? Marissa — I'll ask you to cover how we instrument cost/latency dashboards for the pilot.

If platform needs anything specific (network egress, IP allowlists), Rajesh — share those items and we’ll bring an ops runbook to the session.

Thanks everyone, looking forward to it.

Sean

From: Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@orionhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@orionhealth.com>
Cc: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Orion Health Security <security@orionhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Aug 2025 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot design session — aligning stakeholders, SSO and evidence needs

Thanks — invite received and accepted. A couple of add-ons from platform/security: 
- We’ll need the IP CIDR ranges and any required outbound ports for the pilot.
- Can your team confirm whether a managed KMS or our KMS is required for token encryption during pilot?
- Security will review the SOC2 summary; please send the SOC2 section that specifically covers logging/retention.

I’ve attached our list of questions as a separate doc (we will bring it to the call). Looking forward to the walk-through.

-Rajesh
Principal Platform Engineer, Orion Health
rajesh.patel@orionhealth.com
